ITEM 1 | Bright green floret cluster with a dense, bumpy, tree-like top and a pale green stem, about 5 cm across, sitting at the upper left of the plate, slightly matte with a fresh, firm look | 35
ITEM 2 | Dark green floret cluster with tightly packed small buds and a rounded dome top, about 5 cm across, sitting at the upper center of the plate next to item 1, matte and firm | 40
ITEM 3 | Pale green thick stalk piece with a small attached floret, about 4 cm long and 2 cm wide, lying between items 1 and 4 at the left-center of the plate, smooth and firm | 15
ITEM 4 | Bright green floret cluster with a branched, open structure and pale stem base, about 5 cm across, at the left-center of the plate, matte, fresh and firm | 30
ITEM 5 | Dark green floret cluster with dense buds and a rounded top, about 5 cm across, at the lower center of the plate, matte and firm | 40
ITEM 6 | Small bright green floret piece with a short stem, about 3 cm across, at the lower left edge of the plate beside item 5, matte and firm | 15
ITEM 7 | Bright green floret cluster with a branched, open top and pale stem base, about 4.5 cm across, at the right of the plate, matte, fresh and firm | 25
ITEM 8 | Tiny scattered fragments of green bits and crumbs, a few millimeters each, on the upper right of the plate near the rim | 1
